pages.lesson:
LESSON: PLACES OF WORSHIP

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Religious Practices
Topic 4.2: Places of Worship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Places of Worship. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do celebrations of festivals at places of worship help in inculcating moral values in our lives?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. outline the practices conducted during the festivals at the places of worship for a deeper understanding
2. illustrate the religious practices of the four faiths for community integration

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. outline the practices conducted during the festivals at the places of worship for a deeper understanding
   In simple words: practise until you can outline the practices conducted during the festivals at the places of worship for a deeper understanding. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. illustrate the religious practices of the four faiths for community integration
   In simple words: practise until you can illustrate the religious practices of the four faiths for community integration. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Places of Worship using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Places of Worship in the examples.
2. Explain Places of Worship to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Places of Worship.
4. Show that you can: outline the practices conducted during the festivals at the places of worship for a deeper understanding

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Places of Worship using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Places of Worship important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Use digital devices/digital devices with assistive technology for learners with special needs /resource persons/ library, to research on religious practices,
2. Attend at least one of the listed festivals and discuss their findings with peers,
3. Communication and Collaboration: learner enhances communication and collaboration when attending at least one of the listed festivals.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do celebrations of festivals at places of worship help in inculcating moral values in our lives?
2. Why is it important to celebrate religious festivals at places of worship?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. outline the practices conducted during the festivals at the places of worship for a deeper understanding
2. illustrate the religious practices of the four faiths for community integration

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
